'''Albrek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] noble from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who was nearing the age of seventy by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]]. He and his son [[Albrek (junior)|Albrek]] were broke, but they attempted to buy weapons from [[Magaran]] and promised to sell them to a number of different buyers. [[Tanno Vik]] posed as Magaran and tricked them into meeting with the buyers and then killed the entire group with [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].
